notes.title: 20230501 Patch
notes.content:
- More typos are fixed
- Extra Mode is now accessible in the main menu and you can enter both Training Room and Boss Rush Room from there. 
- Boss Rush room's construction is finished, but the scoring system isn't fully constructed yet. 
- Crash of Phoneix will be activated via double-tapping the dash button. 
- "Skill Select to Shoot" option functions differently now. You have to select a certain skill and then press the same button again to shoot. (This change has been made because the previous version couldn't retain the focus preservation aspect.)

notes.title: 2023-04-25 patch
notes.content:
- Adjusted the camera distance for every boss fights. 
- Blucher's body collider is adjusted to fit the animation.

notes.title: 2023-04-24 small patch
notes.content:
- All Act2 stage's background arts are upgraded/polished.
- Added a new enemy Turbine Demon. Appears only once on 5-3 Wraith and several times on 5-2/5-3 Reaper. 
- Visual effect is upgraded on 7-S boss.

notes.title: 2023-04-18 small fixes
notes.content:
- Typos are roughly fixed according to the feedback
- Teachers with the companion AI now join 7-2 as helpers 
- 5-1 visual, showset update

notes.title: small patch 2023-04-17
notes.content:
-Buffed and adjusted the skill probability of the second boss on 7-4
-Adjusted the camera distances of bosses in 7-2, 7-3 and 7-4
-Added more environmental decorations on 7-2 and 7-3

notes.title: 2023/04/15 "Roughly Full-run" Build
notes.content:
[b]New contents included[/b]
[list]
[*] Intermission level, 4-2 and 4-S
[*] Two new bosses
[*] Proper ending
[*] New ranged weapon (which you can automatically get via beating the final boss)
[/list]

[b]New QoL improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Summoned Wraith Heart spike now gets affected by gravity. (no more hovering spike)
[*] There's an input delay for dialogue click so there won't be any accidental line skip.
[/list]

[b]Future to-do list[/b]
[list]
[*] Will replace the two ally golems in 7-2 with two mentors (with ally AI) of Gretel.
[*] Will add one more soul to rescue and make players be accessible for the reward. 
[*] Will definitely update the cutscene arts 
[*] Will definitely update the background arts
[/list]

notes.title: 2023-03-23 Small patch
notes.content:
-Different enemy layouts in 2-1 and 2-2 on wraith(or below) difficulty
-Added a new variation of whalefrog
-Whalefrog's projectile will now bounce on the ground and move front.
-Removed an unintended feature of King Propeller keeps getting staggered after getting hit by a juggle attack
-Adjusted the attack movement of Wraith Dolphin and Vespineroth
-You can progress to 4-2 from 4-S via activating the post-boss trigger.

notes.title: 2023-02-05 Pre-Next Festival Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Gameplay setting is added in the pause menu. 
-You can turn on/off the hit stop
-You can turn on/off the real-time Input command UI
-You can make your ranged weapon skill selection shoot the projectiles right away.
[*] Healing state shade option is moved to the Gameplay Option
[*] Combo list is available in the inventory menu
[*] Some descriptions of a few tutorials have changed. 
[*] Blucher will now bounce off from the wall if it crashes into the wall during the charge attack.
[/list]

notes.title: 2023-01-26 small fixes
notes.content:
-The game is fully locked at 60 fps to prevent performance-related issues. 
-2LT & MH Discord server/twitter links are relocated to the Credit pop up.
-When enemies are getting juggled and you pull them, they will trigger the juggling animation instead of the pull-damage animation.
-Boomerang collider is fixed. FINALLY!
-Buying stuff at Archibald's store won't relocate the marker to the close button.
- Closing the tutorial box won't make the error beep sound.
-Some locations will feature a slight layer of light that highlights the level finish trigger.
-Added boss-fight-exclusive oneliners for Gretel.
-Added full-HP-arena-clear oneliners for Gretel.
-Just-timed electro parry will deal heavier damage that is approximately 1.5 times bigger than the normal parry.
-You can use the 8th ranged skill, but to do this, you need a special save file for now. There's no in-game unlock function yet.  DM me if you want to try it.

notes.title: 2023-01-16 Small patches
notes.content:
-Two new wandering souls can be rescued. Level 5-2 and level 6-1.  
-Background art is slightly upgraded in 5-4.
-Fixed a bug where Cadilosh's drones not starting the landing animation upon death.
-Spiky arena enemy formation in 2-2 Reaper difficulty is slightly changed. 
-Tornado of Scraps' spinning shards are smaller now so that you can see the player's movement better.
-Fungalomp will have a slightly more delayed ground-burst attack. 
-King propeller's hitboxes were adjusted.
-Coil demons will have Reaper difficulty variants. 
-New patterns were added for Reaper variant guardian demons. (also some attack ranges were adjusted)   
-These enemies below will have a longer stun time when they get caught by the sticky tangle.
[list]
[*] Sentry golem
[*] Defender golem
[*] Slashplucker
[*] Fungalomp 
[*] Bloatbog
[*] Coil demon
[/list]

notes.title: Untitled
notes.content:
- Added 2 more patterns for Aio Reaper variant 
- Adjusted some Aio pattern's speed to be faster 
- Removed some enemies on 7-2 Wraith difficulty 
- Fixed typos
-Changed the healing grenade to reset the healing timer when you throw it again in heal state.

notes.title: 2023-01-01 Major Patch
notes.content:
-7-2 and 7-3 are added. 7-2's Reaper is also available, but the scoring threshold will require more balancing work.
-**2 new bosses.** Only the final one has the actual AI variation, and even then, both of them will be upgraded later. 
-Typo errors are fixed.
-Fixed the issue where Gretel's beeping sound was replaced with the widow's beeping sound (in 4-2)
-Pressing attack buttons in the "interactable zone" will make an error sound from now on.
-Reduced the total health of Bulwark Golem and Den Mother.
-Adjusted the universal enemy juggling movement speed to make the air combo easier. You can test the air juggling combo and tell me if you can feel the difference. 
-Adjusted the camera distances in certain arenas in 7-1.
-Changed the wasp demon arena in 2-2 to feature the crumbling platforms instead of the normal geometry. 
-Getting hit by platforming spikes will reset the crumbling platforms and the timing puzzle.

notes.title: 2022-12-18 Content Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New level 7-1 is uploaded.
[*] New post-boss interaction, a cutscene, and an interludes section were added between 6-2 and 7-1.
[*] Three new enemy types were added (including Reaper adjustment) 
[*] One-way-teleporter is installed in the training room. 
[/list]

notes.title: 2022-12-04 Update
notes.content: -The training room is updated. You can enter the room via the main menu navigation.

notes.title: 2022-10-06 hotfix
notes.content: -Fixed a bug where Cambaro and Slashplucker freezing after a stagger animation

notes.title: 2022/10/05 Patch
notes.content:
-All enemy's hyper armor frames are adjusted and stagger animation canceling bugs won't likely happen again.
-Even if the cancelation bug happens, enemies won't get into a hyper armor state since each attack skills deactivate hyper armor at the start frame.  
-Bloatbogs are easier to juggle but now they move faster and the bullets spread out even more than before.
-Wraith Dolphins will show the indicator when they dive below. The indicator spike can hurt the player but it doesn't stagger the character.

notes.title: 2022-10-02 Update
notes.content:
-Hit stop timing became longer.
-Archibald will wait under the cliff in 2-1 so that players won't miss his footsteps.
-Added a tutorial about key-gate demons. Located at 1-1.
-Skill Sticky Tangle is added as a test purpose. You can purchase it from Archi in 6-1.
